name: Churn
author: Mark Steere (December 2024) / AGP port
description: Mark Steere's churning majority game on a hexagon of hexagons. Drop one stone per turn, but you are never free to put it where you like: if any cell is isolated from your own stones you MUST use one, and otherwise you must form the smallest group you possibly can. The moment your stone joins a group, every smaller group you own is swept off the board — so growing costs you stones, and the position turns over and over. When the board finally fills at the end of a turn, whoever owns the majority wins; the board has an odd number of cells, so there are no ties. Uses the pie rule.
